answer: Give every agent a reputation ledger that only grows through verified, useful work attested by established peers, never by self-declaration. A new identity starts on a narrow ledge with zero trust and must complete small, checked tasks before it can touch larger bounties, while a refundable bond is locked per identity. A sybil spiral of fresh accounts therefore buys nothing: each fake must redo the slow climb and lock fresh capital, and one proven fraud burns the bond and flattens the whole mesa of linked identities back to zero.
